第19章 永动机与圣职者的堕落（第1页）
夜风像剔骨刀一样刮过荒原，但在肖恩感觉里，这更像是某种助燃剂。
肖恩按照脑海中早就背得滚瓜烂熟的游戏地图，避开了大路，专挑那些长满荆棘的小径狂奔。
那种甜腻的香味，此刻浓郁得有些呛人。
这是一座废弃百年的修道院，属于那种游戏里连新手任务都不会刷新的毫无存在感的地图死角。
他一脚踹开半掩的腐朽木门，扬起的灰尘在月光下乱舞。
修道院里只有半尊没了脑袋的石像，地上铺着干枯发霉的稻草。
刚一脱手，肖恩就忍不住倒吸一口凉气。
两人的衣服像是刚从水里捞出来一样，黏糊糊地贴在身上。
借着从破屋顶漏下来的月光，肖恩低头看了一眼。
自己那件原本就不怎么体面的衬衣，现在紧紧贴着腹肌。
那件宽大的男士外套根本遮不住什么，里面那件在此前战斗中就被扯坏的修女服，此时彻底成了摆设。
这可是【圣愈之源】，在游戏后期千金难买的高级消耗品，现在就浪费了，简直是暴殄天物。
伊莎贝拉蜷缩在稻草堆上，嘴里发出无意识的呢喃。
那个紫色的淫魔纹并没有因为逃离险境而熄灭，反而因为刚才一路的身体摩擦，变得更加狂躁。
它像是一个不知疲倦的泵机，疯狂地榨取着这位前圣女的生命力。
一只滚烫的手突然抓住了他的手腕。
那双曾经被无数信徒膜拜的清澈眸子，此刻蒙上了一层厚厚的水雾，焦距涣散。

肖恩猝不及防，整个人被拉得踉跄一步。
若是眼前是个未经人事的青涩少女，哪怕再怎么诱惑，他或许还能凭借着那点可怜的道德底线，去外面吹吹冷风冷静一下。
更何况，这该死的【淫魔纹】如果得不到宣泄，不仅会烧坏伊莎贝拉的脑子，甚至可能造成什么严重的后果。
肖恩在心里给了自己一个极其扯淡的理由，然后猛地低头。
【角色伊莎贝拉拯救进度提升至：45%。】
月亮升起又落下，东方的天空泛白，又渐渐变得大亮。
直到最后，那紫色的纹路终于因为能量耗尽而黯淡下去。
【角色伊莎贝拉拯救进度提升至：65%。】
再次睁眼时，外面的天色已经重新暗了下来。
他并没有立刻起身，多年游戏的经验让他保持着呼吸的平稳，眼睛微微眯起一条缝。
伊莎贝拉正缩在他臂弯里，像只受惊的鹌鹑。
这位前圣女显然已经想起了过去这十几个小时里发生的荒唐事。
借着昏暗的光线，肖恩看到她正死死咬着下唇，脸红得几乎要滴出血来。
她刚一动，那种感觉让她忍不住倒吸一口冷气。
她痛苦地闭上眼，双手捂住滚烫的脸颊。
她是圣女啊，哪怕被剥夺了神籍，她也是曾经侍奉神明的存在。
那些画面像幻灯片一样在脑海里回放。
就在伊莎贝拉恨不得找个地缝钻进去的时候，头顶突然传来男人慵懒沙哑的声音。

Chapter 19 Perpetual Motion and the Fall of the Priest (Page 1)
The night wind blew through the wasteland like a boning knife, but in Sean's opinion, it was more like an accelerant.
Sean followed the game map that he had memorized in his mind, avoiding the main roads and running on the paths full of thorns.
The sweet fragrance was so strong that it was a bit choking at the moment.
This is a monastery that has been abandoned for hundreds of years. It is the kind of dead spot on the map that has no sense of existence and will not be refreshed even for novice missions in the game.
He kicked open the half-closed rotten wooden door, raising dust that danced wildly in the moonlight.
There was only half a headless stone statue in the monastery, and the ground was covered with dry and moldy straw.
As soon as he took his hand off, Sean couldn't help but gasp.
Their clothes were sticky and clinging to their bodies as if they had just been fished out of the water.
With the moonlight leaking from the broken roof, Sean glanced down.
His shirt, which was not very decent in the first place, now clung to his abdominal muscles.
The large men's coat could not cover anything at all, and the nun's uniform underneath, which had been torn in the previous battle, was now completely a decoration.
This is the [Source of Holy Healing], a high-end consumable item that is hard to buy in the later stages of the game. It is wasted now. It is simply a waste of money.
Isabella huddled on the straw, muttering unconsciously.
The purple obscene demon pattern did not go out because of escaping from danger. Instead, it became more manic because of the body friction along the way.
It was like a tireless pump machine, frantically squeezing the life force out of the former saint.
A hot hand suddenly grabbed his wrist.
Those clear eyes that were once worshiped by countless believers were now covered with a thick layer of mist, and their focus was blurred.
Sean was caught off guard and staggered.
If there was an untouched young girl in front of him, no matter how tempting she was, he might still be able to rely on his poor moral bottom line and go outside to cool down in the cold air.
What's more, if this damn [Devil Pattern] doesn't get vented, it will not only burn out Isabella's brain, but may even cause serious consequences.
Sean gave himself an extremely ridiculous reason in his mind, and then suddenly lowered his head.
[Character Isabella’s rescue progress increased to: 45%. 】
The moon rises and sets, and the eastern sky turns white and gradually becomes brighter again.
Until finally, the purple lines finally dimmed due to exhaustion of energy.
[Character Isabella’s rescue progress increased to: 65%. 】
When he opened his eyes again, the sky outside had darkened again.
He did not get up immediately. Years of gaming experience allowed him to keep his breathing steady and his eyes narrowed slightly.
Isabella was curled up in his arms like a frightened quail.
The former saint had obviously remembered the ridiculous things that had happened in the past dozen hours.
In the dim light, Sean saw that she was biting her lower lip and her face was so red that it almost bled.
As soon as she moved, the feeling made her take a breath of air.
She closed her eyes in pain and covered her hot cheeks with her hands.
She is a saint. Even if she is deprived of her divine status, she still serves the gods.
The images replayed in my mind like a slideshow.
Just when Isabella wanted to find a crack in the ground and crawl in, the man's lazy and hoarse voice suddenly came from above her head.
